user.description: The base controller holds the settings for all shutters. Add the shutters afterwards on the integration page.

calibrate.title: Calibrate
calibrate.description:
First the assistant looks for the point where the bottom bar leaves the sill: from closed it moves up in small steps and asks whether the bar has lifted. Then it measures four points spread over the travel above that point, from closed and from open, and asks each time how far the window is open below the bottom bar. Automatic control of this shutter is paused meanwhile.

Enter the window height to measure in cm, or leave it empty to estimate in % of the window.

add_point.title: Add a calibration point
add_point.description: The shutter first moves to closed (↑) or open (↓), then to the module position, and asks for the opening.

cal_measure.title: Measure
cal_measure.description: The shutter is at module position {position} % ({direction}) {reached}. How far is the window open below the bottom bar ({unit})? 0 if the bar is still on the sill.

cal_lift.title: Bottom bar
cal_lift.description: Module position {position} % from closed. Has the bottom bar left the sill?
